meta.name: Drata
meta.title: Drata ad teardown: three strong logos, six fields for a replay
meta.meta_desc: A teardown of Drata’s live LinkedIn ad: A-LIGN, AWS and Drata make a credible webinar offer, then the page buries the sharp headline and asks six fields for an on-demand replay.
meta.og_desc: Three strong logos. Six fields for a replay.
meta.keywords: drata linkedin ads, drata ad teardown, compliance software ads, EU AI Act ads, ISO 42001, webinar landing page, ad teardown
meta.card_desc: A-LIGN, AWS and Drata make a credible offer, then a clunky headline and six fields sit in front of a replay.

hook: Three strong logos earned the click.
Six fields stand in front of the replay.
voice.lede: This is a well-built ad. A-LIGN, AWS and Drata on one creative give a GRC buyer a real reason to care, and the page keeps the same speakers and the same topic. The friction arrives at the end: the sharp creative headline turns into a clunky page title, and an on-demand webinar sits behind six required fields and a 190-country dropdown.

findings.title: Three brands a GRC buyer trusts
findings.what: A-LIGN, AWS and Drata appear as logos on the creative. For this audience that is real credibility, and it matches the promise of expert speakers in the copy.

findings.title: The creative beats the headline
findings.what: “A practical framework for using ISO 42001 to support EU AI Act compliance” is on the creative. “Simplify Your AI Compliance Strategy” is the vaguer line above it.
findings.fix: Use the creative’s line as the ad headline too.

findings.title: A generic hook over real topics
findings.what: The topics are specific, but “without doubling your compliance workload” could sit on any compliance ad. There is no concrete finding to tease.
findings.fix: Tease one thing the webinar reveals about where the EU AI Act and ISO overlap.

findings.title: The message survives the click
findings.what: Same speakers, same topics, same EU AI Act and ISO 42001 framing. The reader lands exactly where the ad said they would.

findings.title: A clunky title replaces the sharp one
findings.what: “Best Practices: Aligning EU AI Act, ISO Standards & AI Governance for Scalable Compliance” is accurate, and it buries the sharper line from the creative.
findings.fix: Open the page with the creative’s headline.

findings.title: Six fields for a replay
findings.what: Six required fields and a 190-country dropdown is heavy for an on-demand watch, even with the right audience.
findings.fix: Cut the form to what sales actually uses, and let the replay do the qualifying.

faq.q: What works in Drata’s LinkedIn ad?
faq.a: The proof. A-LIGN, AWS and Drata together on the creative carry real weight with a GRC audience, and the page keeps the same message.

faq.q: How many fields should a webinar replay form have?
faq.a: As few as sales actually uses. An on-demand replay is a low-commitment offer, so a long form makes the trade feel uneven.
Cut the form and carry the creative’s headline onto the page. The ad and the message are already working.

issues.title: Headline Clarity
issues.explanation: 'A practical framework for using ISO 42001 to support EU AI Act compliance' on the creative is sharper than the ad copy's vaguer 'Simplify Your AI Compliance Strategy.'

issues.title: CTA Friction
issues.explanation: 'Watch Now' on the creative is clear and fits an on-demand asset, but the LP form has six fields plus a giant country dropdown, more friction than a webinar replay needs.

issues.title: Visual-Copy Match
issues.explanation: Creative headline, 'on-demand webinar' tag and three logos (A-LIGN, AWS, Drata) match the ad body's promise of experts covering EU AI Act and ISO overlap.

issues.title: Benefit Specificity
issues.explanation: Ad lists real topics (overlap, scalable framework, high-risk prep) but 'how to keep up without doubling your compliance workload' is a generic hook, not a concrete teaser finding.

issues.title: Trust Signals
issues.explanation: Three named co-presenting brands (A-LIGN, AWS, Drata) shown as logos on the creative give strong credibility for a LinkedIn asset.
